blocks.text:
Renewal check-in with Quillon Supply Co. on Oct 6, 2026, ahead of the Dec 31 contract renewal. Rosa reports about 96 percent on-time pickups this year and a preference to stay if terms are reasonable. Open issues are two disputed September detention charges at the west yard and a request for Saturday pickups if a planned February Saturday shift goes ahead.

Volume is about 300 pallets a month and expected to grow about 15 percent next year to roughly 345. Procurement has a second quote from Bellwick Logistics and wants to decide by the end of November.

items.text: Email the two disputed detention invoice numbers and the dock logs.
Send the disputed detention charges to billing for review.
Check Saturday pickup coverage at the main warehouse.
Send renewal terms covering the higher volume and the Saturday option.
Send calendar invite for the renewal review.

blocks.title: Follow-up email (draft)
blocks.subject: Renewal next steps and Nov 5 review
blocks.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for the update today, and for the feedback on pickups.

Next steps
- Detention charges: when you send the two invoice numbers and the dock logs, I will pass them to billing for review.
- Saturday pickups: I am checking Saturday coverage at the main warehouse so it can be included as an option.
- Renewal terms: I will send our proposal by Oct 30, based on about 345 pallets a month and the Saturday option.

We will review the proposal together on Thursday, Nov 5 at 2 pm. I will send the invite.

Best regards,
Tessa Harlow
Account Manager, Marrowbay Logistics

items.label: Est. monthly volume
items.value: About 300 pallets now; about 345 expected next year

items.label: Competitors mentioned
items.value: Bellwick Logistics (second quote requested by procurement)

items.label: Risks
items.value: Competing quote; two disputed detention charges; decision due end of November

items.text: Invoice numbers for the two disputed detention charges were not given on the call.
Saturday shift start (February) is not confirmed. It depends on approval from Quillon's operations director.
No date set for Rosa to send the invoice numbers and dock logs.
Renewal date, proposal deadline and next meeting time were stated on the call.
